risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed PS5 (worst case: treat as controllers-only / cannot verify console), so use the lowest matching comparable only if you later confirm it is PS5.

risks.risk: Game bundle may be incomplete or not FIFA 2025 (disc/case not shown).

risks.risk: PS5 model/storage (Slim vs original, 1TB vs other) is unknown; this affects value.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the console model label/spec sticker (or system settings screen showing model and storage).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest-spec/least valuable PS5 variant.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo showing the actual PS5 console body (front + back ports) in the same frame as the controllers.
Send a photo of the FIFA 2025 disc/case (front cover) and confirm it is included.
Send a photo of the PS5 model/storage label or a screenshot from Settings showing model and storage.
Send a short video of the PS5 powering on to the home screen and (if possible) launching FIFA 2025.
